Interface RegulatedMotor

All Superinterfaces:
Motor
public interface RegulatedMotor extends Motor
A motor with encoder feedback and closed-loop speed/position control.

Speeds and accelerations are expressed in degrees per second and degrees per second squared. Tachometer positions and rotation arguments are expressed in motor-shaft degrees. A rotation with immediateReturn == false waits until the requested motion completes; a rotation with immediateReturn == true starts the motion and returns immediately.
